readout_other: compound action potential parameters (amplitude, AUC, latencies, rate of rise, half peak width); nerve temperature; H&E, Luxol Fast Blue, Masson's Trichrome, Bielschowsky histology
direction_notes: Increasing HIFU pressure decreased CAP amplitude, area under the curve and rate of rise until amplitude reached zero; nerve temperature rose by over 60 C above baseline at peak.
safety_notes: At the highest HIFU pressures (high HIFU arm) myelin sheaths were expanded by clear spaces and fibres not identifiable on histology; control and low HIFU nerves looked normal.

exposures.label: HIFU of ex vivo rat sciatic nerve in a bath

timing.protocol_description: Pulse train of 25 ms on and 25 ms off (duty cycle 50%) applied for 15 s; HIFU reapplied every 2 min at pressures increasing in 0.11 MPa increments from 1.30 MPa until the CAP amplitude fell to zero; CAPs recorded 30 and 90 s after the start of each application.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Ten nerves from six rats (100% male, mean weight 545 g) were used for bupivacaine experiments; ten nerves from six rats (100% male, mean weight 558 g) were used for ropivacaine experiments, and 26 nerves from 18 rats (77% male, mean weight 518 g, mean nerve diameter 1.8 mm) were used for HIFU experiments (table 1).
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: A HIFU transducer (100 mm radius of curvature) with a resonant frequency of 1.47 megahertz was used.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_duration_ms: A pulse train (each pulse was on for a duration of 25 ms, followed by an off period of 25 ms, for a duty cycle of 50%) was applied for 15 s.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.duty_cycle_pct: A pulse train (each pulse was on for a duration of 25 ms, followed by an off period of 25 ms, for a duty cycle of 50%) was applied for 15 s.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: A pulse train (each pulse was on for a duration of 25 ms, followed by an off period of 25 ms, for a duty cycle of 50%) was applied for 15 s.
source_quotes.exposures[0].unspecified_domain.ispta_w_: HIFU pressures used ranged from 1.30 to 2.87 MPa, corresponding to spatial peak temporal average intensities (Ispta) of 52.0 to 255.5 W/cm<sup>2</sup>.
source_quotes.exposures[0].unspecified_domain.pressure: HIFU pressures used ranged from 1.30 to 2.87 MPa, corresponding to spatial peak temporal average intensities (Ispta) of 52.0 to 255.5 W/cm<sup>2</sup>.

Ispta given as corresponding to pressures; paper says intensities are estimates based on assumed nerve acoustic impedance
HIFU experiments used 26 nerves from 18 rats; a separate histology cohort of 20 nerves from 10 rats included 'low HIFU' and 'high HIFU' arms; recorded 26 preparations
PRF not stated; only 25 ms on / 25 ms off given
